description: Fresh self-authored fractions, ratios, and percent MCQs. This scaffold deliberately uses terminating fractions and integer percent results so today's numeric ADJ path can verify the option-selection mechanism before the exact-rational engine work expands the rung.

items.stem: A recipe uses 1/2 of an 18 ounce bag of flour. How many ounces of flour are used?
Maya reads 3/4 of a 24 page chapter. How many pages does she read?
A tank is 5/8 full and holds 32 gallons when full. How many gallons are in the tank?
A trail is 35 miles long. Jordan bikes 2/5 of the trail. How many miles does Jordan bike?
A music file is 50 megabytes. A preview downloads 7/10 of the file. How many megabytes download?
What is 1/2 + 1/4?
What is 3/4 + 1/2?
What is 7/8 - 1/8?
What is 5/4 - 1/2?
What is 1/2 of 3/4?
A store discounts an 80 dollar jacket by 25 percent, meaning 25 out of 100. How many dollars is the discount?
A class has 250 students. If 10 percent, meaning 10 out of 100, join chess club, how many students join?
A phone battery has 64 units of charge. If 50 percent, meaning 50 out of 100, remains, how many units remain?
A camp has 40 cabins. If 75 percent, meaning 75 out of 100, are occupied, how many cabins are occupied?
A shelf holds 45 books. If 20 percent, meaning 20 out of 100, are paperbacks, how many paperbacks are on the shelf?
A team attempts 120 free throws. If it makes 40 percent, meaning 40 out of 100, how many free throws does it make?
A drink mix uses 3 cups juice for every 2 cups water. If there are 8 cups water, how many cups juice are needed?
A map scale says 4 centimeters represent 10 kilometers. If two towns are 12 centimeters apart on the map, how many kilometers apart are they?
4 tickets cost 36 dollars. At the same rate, how many dollars do 6 tickets cost?
A printer makes 30 pages in 5 minutes. At the same rate, how many pages does it make in 8 minutes?
